text:
Ava (Growth): Quick pulse — launch post + webinar snapshot is up on the deck. CTR looks fine but MQLs from paid are down ~18% vs last week. Can people scan and flag anything obvious? :mag:
Miguel (Analytics): looking now. early note: landing page bounce for the webinar spike at 11:12 PST for the paid cohort.
Priya (Marketing Ops): did we change the UTM rules for paid? I remember touching the campaign param mapping last Thursday.
Elliott (Product Marketing): not that I know of, Priya. We pushed a copy tweak to the launch post yesterday (headline). Could be messaging misalignment.
Miguel (Analytics): small experiment: filter by utm_campaign exact vs partial. if some sources got truncated they fall into (none) bucket. quick SQL I ran:
```
SELECT utm_campaign, count(*) as leads
FROM events
WHERE event = 'convert' AND date >= '2026-04-01'
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY leads DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
Miguel (Analytics): the top rows show a new blank-campaign grouping — looks like ad platform started dropping the ?utm_campaign param on some third-party redirectors.
Priya (Marketing Ops): ahhh — that matches a ticket I filed with the ad ops vendor about their redirect layers. Ticket #AO-412 still open. I'll paste the thread.
Priya (Marketing Ops): @Elliott can you confirm the headline tweak didn't change the ad creative? I'm trying to rule out messaging vs tracking.
Elliott (Product Marketing): creative is the same asset ID. headline tweak only applied to the organic launch post copy, not the paid creative.
Ava (Growth): ok so priority = tracking fix + a near-term routing fallback. Can we add a fallback on the dashboard to attribute to last known campaign if utm missing? even a heuristic is fine for the weekly report.
Miguel (Analytics): I can add a 'heuristic_campaign' column — fallback to referer parse -> ad domain mapping -> last non-null campaign in session. I'll add to the daily ETL and push as a new viz.
Miguel (Analytics): ETA ~ 40m to land in BI (need to rejig the join).
deploy-bot: dashboard "launchpad_kpis_v2" updated by Miguel. view: https://bi.redwood/example/launchpad_kpis_v2
Ava (Growth): nice — once that lands can we re-run the week-over-week? I want the KPI email to reflect corrected attribution before Friday AM send.
Priya (Marketing Ops): I'll add a note in the KPI email: "preliminary numbers may shift due to attribution cleanup" and link to the ticket.
Elliott (Product Marketing): also a quick thought — for next webinar, let's add a hidden campaign token in the registration form so server records campaign independent of client-side UTMs. low lift.
Ava (Growth): love it. assign follow-ups: Priya owns vendor ticket + email note, Miguel implements heuristic ETL, Elliott owns hidden-token requirement for registration, I'll own re-run & Friday KPI email.
Priya (Marketing Ops): noted. ping me in #launch-ops when heuristic lands and I'll cross-check registration signups.
Miguel (Analytics): will do. posting interim numbers in ~45.
Ava (Growth): thanks all :thumbsup: — small ops win if we get this tightened before the next paid push.
__notes: thread follows Slack style: short messages, @mentions, emoji, small SQL block. No title field per agents.md rules.
